module.Title: Build an Emergency-Stop Interlock
module.Teaching: not reverses a Boolean. A motor may start only when the emergency stop is not active.
module.ExampleCode:
if start_button and not guard_open:
    print("Motor starting")
module.TargetCode:
if start_button and not emergency_stop:
    print("Motor starting")
module.FillStarter:
if start_button and ___ emergency_stop:
    print("Motor starting")
PredictionOptions: The emergency stop is not active
module.PredictionExplanation: not converts False to True, allowing the safe condition to pass.
module.BrokenCode:
if start_button and emergency_stop:
    print("Motor starting")
module.DebugPrompt: The unsafe version starts specifically while the emergency stop is active.
module.RecallPrompt: Rebuild the start-button and emergency-stop interlock. Use these exact identifiers: emergency_stop, print, start_button. Use the exact value "Motor starting".
module.TransferPrompt: Start a fan only when command_on is True and smoke_alarm is False. Use the exact identifier print. Use the exact value "Fan starting".
module.TransferCode:
if command_on and not smoke_alarm:
    print("Fan starting")
module.PreviewMessage: The simulated equipment now respects an emergency interlock.
